fields.name: model
fields.title: Model
fields.description: Model variant: berry favors quality, jam favors speed.

fields.name: image_size
fields.title: Image Size
fields.description: Output size, rounded up to multiples of 16, at most 4,220,160 total pixels (1680×2512). auto lets the prompt expander pick the aspect ratio at about 2048×2048.

fields.name: reasoning_level
fields.title: Reasoning Level
fields.description: How much effort the harness spends reasoning about the given prompt. Higher reasoning effort means slower generation time. Both levels bill $0.025 per output megapixel.

fields.name: negative_prompt
fields.title: Negative Prompt
fields.description: What to keep out of the image. Used by berry only.

fields.name: seed
fields.title: Seed
fields.description: Latent noise seed. Use a new seed when editing a previous output again.
